Conversion/replacement?.note: A Power Engineering article from October 2015 says the Illinois EPA issued a permit for NRG to convert the coal units 6 to 8 at the Joliet plant to burn natural gas. It says units 7 and 8 are part of Joliet 29. So both units were converted from coal to gas.

units.notes: Conversion is supported by a 2015 trade article. I found no document that speaks of carbon capture at this plant, and no document that states the city beyond the EIA table, which gives the county only.
